title: Renamed fleet-e2b/e4b to fleet-light/fleet-heavy
rationale: Decouples inference worker names from Gemma model sizes so the underlying model can be swapped without renaming the entire surface. Worker capability (light=fast, heavy=deep) is more stable than model identity.

title: Provider socket architecture over ACP CLI adapters
rationale: ACP CLI adapters (cc, gmi, codex-acp) added process overhead and made rate-limit handling opaque. Unix socket workers give the harness direct control over retry, hibernation, and prompt construction.
